Package pl.polsl.model

Class GameModel

java.lang.Object
pl.polsl.model.AbstractGameModel
pl.polsl.model.GameModel
public class GameModel extends AbstractGameModel
The GameModel class represents the core game logic of the 5x5 word guessing game.

It stores the secret word, keeps track of the user's attempts and feedback, and provides methods to check guesses, validate the game state, and retrieve information.

This class is part of the Model component in the MVC pattern and contains no input/output operations.

  • Method Details

    • checkGuess

      public String checkGuess(String guess) throws InvalidGuessException
      Description copied from class: AbstractGameModel
      Checks the player's guess against the secret word and generates feedback.

      This method evaluates each letter of the guess and returns feedback indicating:

      • '+' indicates the letter is in the correct position
      • '?' indicates the letter is in the secret word but in a different position
      • '-' indicates the letter is not in the secret word
      Specified by:
      checkGuess in class AbstractGameModel
      Parameters:
      guess - the word guessed by the player
      Returns:
      a string representing the feedback for the guess
      Throws:
      InvalidGuessException - if the player attempts to guess after reaching the maximum number of tries

    • restart

      public void restart()
      Description copied from class: AbstractGameModel
      Resets the game state to start a new game.

      Clears the results list, resets the attempt counter, and sets the game as not won. The secret word remains unchanged unless overridden by concrete implementations.

      Specified by:
      restart in class AbstractGameModel

    • saveCurrentGameToHistory

      public void saveCurrentGameToHistory()
      Description copied from class: AbstractGameModel
      Saves the current game session to the game history.

      This method should be called when a game ends (either by winning or running out of attempts) to preserve the game data for historical tracking and statistics.

      Specified by:
      saveCurrentGameToHistory in class AbstractGameModel
